title: run_event producers: the board finally sees a live run
description:
The run_event protocol in schemas/websocket/messages.schema.json has existed with NO producers — tick zjp retired its vestigial ralph/swarm source values for substrate-shaped ones (cloud:orchestrator, cloud:worker, harness, herdr, pi) precisely so the first real producer would emit something honest.

Phase 2 makes the orchestrator and workers emit run_event to the RunRoom, which forwards to the existing ProjectRoom so the board shows a run live, from anywhere. Two constraints:
- The board is OBSERVABILITY, never authority. A badge is not evidence; collect remains the only completion authority.
- Costs in the stream come from AI Gateway telemetry (k2s), not agent self-report — the protocol carries costUsd and it must not become a place where a self-report re-enters through the side door.
acceptance_criteria: A cloud run appears live on the board with per-tick state from anywhere; the emitted source values are the substrate-shaped ones; a run whose events are dropped still completes and still collects correctly, proving the stream is observability rather than control.
